posts.title: ENYO 10-Year Anniversary
posts.description: On September 7th, 2016, after my breakthrough with Card Crawl (released in March 2015), I released my “second” game, ENYO, a small-scale tactical roguelike. Earlier that year, heavily inspired by Hoplite, one of my all-time favourites, I had created a 7DRL game jam version of ENYO called Hook & Shield. I teamed up with Winnie […]

posts.title: First Month of Card Crawl 2
posts.description: On the 26th of March 2026, exactly 11 years and 6 days after releasing the original Card Crawl back in 2015, we released Card Crawl 2 on iOS and Android. Card Crawl 2 was developed as a true sequel to the original and is my first game that is actually a sequel to any of […]

posts.title: Card Crawl 2 OUT NOW
posts.description: After about 14 Month of development time Card Crawl 2 is out now! You can download the game on the App Store or Google Play, visit its website or watch a gameplay video here. As always a big thanks to everyone that has helped to get the game out!
